title: Azure App Service
description: Deploy and scale .NET applications on Azure App Service.

data.text: Azure App Service provides managed hosting for web apps. Deploy from GitHub, configure scaling slots, and use deployment slots for safe releases.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use deployment slots for safe releases
data.takeaway: Azure App Service simplifies web app deployment. Use deployment slots for zero-downtime releases and auto-scaling for cost optimization.
